**Risk flags:**  
- Single shareholder holds 74.26%

**Overview:**  
Unity Cahaya Bina Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited construction firm based in Kuala Lumpur that specialises in renovation and interior fit‑out for offices. The company was incorporated on 25 May 2002 and has a paid‑up share capital of RM 1,000,000, with three directors and a dominant shareholder owning 74.26% of the equity. Reported revenues have risen from RM 19,399,581 to RM 21,288,282 across the three most recent financial statements, while equity increased from RM 11,254,535 to RM 12,434,965. No legal cases are recorded, and audit opinions or profitability metrics are not provided.
